With e=v-u, subtraction gives transport by v and (e dot grad)u; e=0 at the common wall kills convection, pressure and diffusion boundary terms even for nonzero shared wall velocity. Differentiating the energy is justified uniformly on compact closure; regularized sqrt(Y+delta^2) handles zero error without division and integrating factor gives the rich claimed estimate. Source5 gravity mode has exact same h,g,k, vertical G, real phase and positive omega0. Rescaling t by c_sigma=sqrt(1+sigma k^2/(rho g)) and potential amplitude by c_sigma preserves bottom/kinematic condition; dynamic equation cancels using c_sigma^2=1+sigma k^2/(rho g). Coefficient identity gives a omega_sigma/(k tanh(kh)) without division by a; sigma=0 is exact original mode. General energy theorem uses C1-in-time C2-in-space fields extending past the closed rectangular slab; Green first identity with phi_t/phi meets asymmetric regularity. Paired periodic faces and impermeable bed remove flux; top derivative cancels the gravity and surface-gradient energy derivatives by dynamic and kinematic conditions. At sigma=0, positive frequency roots agree and coefficient a omega0/(k tanh kh)=ag/omega0, including zero amplitude. Rationalizing the difference gives nonnegative numerator sigma k^3 tanh(kh)/rho divided by omega_sigma+omega0>=omega0>0, so one-sided limit is zero.
